sloka: कुश चीर अजिन धरम् फल मूल अशनम् च माम् ।विद्धि प्रणिहितम् धर्मे तापसम् वन गोचरम् ॥२-५०-४४॥
transliteration: kuśa cīra ajina dharam phala mūla aśanam ca mām ।viddhi praṇihitam dharme tāpasam vana gocaram ॥2-50-44॥

translations.english: "Know me for an ascetic ranging the forest, wearing kusha and bark and deerskin, living on fruit and root, and set upon dharma."
